items.source: For a comprehensive set of String escaping utilities, consider Apache Commons Text and its StringEscapeUtils class. We do not use that class here in order to avoid a runtime dependency on Commons Text just for HTML escaping. Furthermore, Spring's HTML escaping is more flexible and 100% HTML 4.0 compliant.
items.translation: 对于全面的字符串转义工具集，可以考虑 Apache Commons Text 及其 `StringEscapeUtils` 类。我们在此处不使用该类，以避免仅为 HTML 转义而引入对 Commons Text 的运行时依赖。此外，Spring 的 HTML 转义功能更加灵活，且完全符合 HTML 4.0 标准。

items.source: Escapes all special characters to their corresponding entity reference (for example, <).
items.translation: 将所有特殊字符转义为其对应的实体引用（例如，`<`）。

items.source: Escapes all special characters to their corresponding entity reference (for example, <) at least as required by the specified encoding. In other words, if a special character does not have to be escaped for the given encoding, it may not be.
items.translation: 将所有特殊字符转义为其对应的实体引用（例如，`<`），至少满足指定编码的要求。换句话说，如果某个特殊字符在给定编码中不需要转义，则不应对其进行转义。

items.source: Escapes all special characters to their corresponding numeric reference in decimal format (&#Decimal;).
items.translation: 将所有特殊字符转义为十进制格式的相应数字引用（&#Decimal;）。

items.source: Escapes all special characters to their corresponding numeric reference in decimal format (&#Decimal;) at least as required by the specified encoding. In other words, if a special character does not have to be escaped for the given encoding, it may not be.
items.translation: 将所有特殊字符转义为其对应十进制格式的数值引用（&#Decimal;），至少满足指定编码的要求。换句话说，如果某个特殊字符在给定编码中不需要转义，则不应对其进行转义。

items.source: Escapes all special characters to their corresponding numeric reference in hex format (&#xHex;).
items.translation: 将所有特殊字符转义为十六进制格式的对应数字引用（&#xHex;）。

items.source: Escapes all special characters to their corresponding numeric reference in hex format (&#xHex;) at least as required by the specified encoding. In other words, if a special character does not have to be escaped for the given encoding, it may not be.
items.translation: 将所有特殊字符转义为其对应的十六进制格式（`&#xHex;`）的数值引用，至少满足指定编码的要求。换句话说，如果某个特殊字符对于给定的编码不需要转义，则不应对其进行转义。
